cues.text: Attendance already taken, but you spotted a mistake? Here's how to correct it safely, with no duplicates.
Open Manual Entry from the Attendance menu, then pick the same class and the same date.
The blue notice says records already exist for this date, so saving updates them instead of creating new ones.
The saved statuses load automatically. To fix a mistake, just tap the student's status.
Now press Save Attendance. The confirmation says the records were updated, and nothing was created twice.
That's it. Corrections are safe, so fix attendance any time.
